observation: Fresh main now requires the explicit commands container to be an array, but individual entries were still coerced with String(...). Non-string entries therefore became unintended shell text, while whitespace-only strings reached runCommand and could escape the structured acceptance-receipt path as COMMAND_REQUIRED.
changes: Require every supplied validation command entry to be a string instead of coercing arbitrary values into shell text.
Treat whitespace-only strings like empty validation entries so the existing VALIDATION_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED gate remains structured.
Return malformed command-entry failures through the existing VALIDATION_COMMAND_INPUT_INVALID receipt path before shell execution.

truth_boundary: This cycle validates only the established shell-command string envelope and structured receipt behavior. It does not choose which commands should validate a project.
